name: KOSSAN
recent: Kossan 近期出现多项大股东持股变动申报，涉及 EPF、Aberdeen 系基金及董事 Lim Kuang Yong。另有公告披露一项清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理人事项，以及一名董事在闭市期内的交易意向通知。
notable: 大股东 EPF、Aberdeen Group plc、abrdn Holdings、abrdn Malaysia 及董事 Lim Kuang Yong 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
公司于 2026-10-27 公告一项清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理人事项。
集团董事经理兼 CEO Tan Sri Dato' Lim Kuang Sia 等多名董事发出闭市期内交易意向通知。
risks: 公司公告一项清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理人事项，具体对象与影响未在标题中说明。
多名董事在闭市期内发出交易意向通知，后续可能出现董事买卖股份。
大股东 Aberdeen 系基金及 EPF 近期持股变动频繁，股权结构存在变动。
earnings: 截至 2026-06-30 季度，营收为 MYR 568.875 million，环比增长 20.9%，同比增长 48.8%；净利为 MYR 64.465 million，环比增长 63.1%，同比增长 106.9%；净利率为 11.3%，高于上一季度的 8.4%。

recent_en: Kossan recently saw multiple substantial shareholder filings involving EPF, Aberdeen-related funds and director Lim Kuang Yong. There was also an announcement on winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator, plus a director's intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: Substantial shareholders EPF, Aberdeen Group plc, abrdn Holdings, abrdn Malaysia and director Lim Kuang Yong filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
The company announced a winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator matter on 2026-10-27.
Group Managing Director/CEO Tan Sri Dato' Lim Kuang Sia and several other directors issued notices of intention to deal during the closed period.
risks_en: The company announced a winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator matter; the specific entity and impact are not stated in the title.
Several directors issued notices of intention to deal during the closed period, so director share dealings may follow.
Aberdeen-related funds and EPF have been actively changing their holdings recently, indicating shifts in the shareholding structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 568.875 million, up 20.9% QoQ and 48.8% YoY; net income was MYR 64.465 million, up 63.1% QoQ and 106.9% YoY; net margin was 11.3% versus 8.4% in the previous quarter.
